name: Moment-constrained threshold-occupancy pairing stress test
scenario_a: Threshold-avoiding assignment: locally reduce the number of pairs with TC minus HDL at least 160 mg/dL, while preserving the fixed marginals, HDL <= TC, and the mean individual ratio.
scenario_b: Threshold-enriching assignment: locally increase that number under the same constraints.
interpretation: Two mathematical sensitivity scenarios, not fitted clinical dependence models or certified global bounds. Neither specifies a target threshold fraction.
marginals: Use the supplied sorted arrays without alteration.
weight_interpretation: Equal-weight synthetic records approximate the source weighted distribution; no individual survey weights are reconstructed.
